entities.summary: Alexander Ruuttu is an American born Finnish professional ice hockey forward. He is currently playing for Adler Mannheim in the Deutsche Eishockey Liga. Ruuttu was selected by the Phoenix Coyotes in the 2nd round of the 2011 NHL Entry Draft. Ruuttu was part of KalPa's Spengler Cup Championship winning team in 2018.
